scenarios.title: A｜错误收费
scenarios.setting: 在“处理费用争议”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“错误收费”。

turns.text: Here’s your final bill. Please take a moment to review it.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Excuse me, I think there’s a mistake on my bill.

feedback.naturalExpression: Excuse me, I think there’s a mistake on my bill.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I don’t recognize one of these charges.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t recognize one of these charges.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Could you explain this charge to me?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you explain this charge to me?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I think I’ve been charged for something I didn’t use.

choices.text: Could you please remove it if it’s incorrect?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you please remove it if it’s incorrect?
